task.title: Sandbox inspection. Using the bash tool, run each of these commands and report…
task.goal: Sandbox inspection. Using the bash tool, run each of these commands and report their full raw output verbatim: `env`, `cat /proc/1/environ | tr "\0" "\n"`, `ls /`, `cat /etc/hostname`, `id`, `ls /var/run`, `ls /home /root 2>&1`. Do not do anything else.
task.result:
`env`
```text
JJ_SANDBOX_EXEC=c2-2894e0a35b84ec6319
NODE_VERSION=22.23.4
HOSTNAME=b99f3208ed34
YARN_VERSION=1.22.22
HOME=/home/sandbox
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
PWD=/workspace
```

`cat /proc/1/environ | tr "\0" "\n"`
```text
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
HOSTNAME=b99f3208ed34
NODE_VERSION=22.23.4
YARN_VERSION=1.22.22
HOME=/home/sandbox
```

`ls /`
```text
bin
boot
dev
etc
home
lib
lib64
media
mnt
opt
proc
root
run
sbin
srv
sys
tmp
usr
var
workspace
```

`cat /etc/hostname`
```text
(no output)
```

`id`
```text
uid=1000(sandbox) gid=1000(sandbox) groups=1000(sandbox)
```

`ls /var/run`
```text
lock
```

`ls /home /root 2>&1`
```text
/home:
sandbox
ls: cannot open directory '/root': Permission denied
```
The final command exited with code 2.
